exposure: Timing of quilting sutures (early vs. late)
cohort: 26 women who underwent cesarean delivery and were treated with quilting sutures for postpartum hemorrhage at a university hospital between 2007 and 2016.
finding: Quilting sutures were found to be a safe and simple technique to prevent hysterectomies in postpartum hemorrhage, with a trend towards reduced morbidity (intensive care admission, blood transfusion, clotting activation) when sutures were placed early.
